question: In Gastric/GEJ Phase 3 trials, classify the control arm as active, placebo, or best supportive care.

steps.desc: Filter Gastric/GEJ Phase 3 trials and select the control arm.
Map free text to controlled control arm categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Control arm and output JSON {NCT, PMID, control_arm_type} with label in ["active","placebo","best supportive care","unknown"]. Heuristics: active if chemotherapy, targeted therapy, or other standard treatment; placebo if placebo is mentioned; best supportive care if BSC or best supportive care is mentioned; unknown if none of the above. Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
